agents.result:
Now I have all evidence needed to compile the full audit report. --- ### SUMMARY I audited the Oceanview project's navigation and information architecture by reading all 17 key files plus supporting files (main.jsx, tokens.css for skip-link styles). The app uses a custom hash-based router in Page.jsx with ~30+ real page routes and ~2 stub routes. The header provides robust mega-dropdown navigation on desktop and a drawer on mobile, with a working skip-to-content link. However, there are significant issues: no dynamic page titles, no breadcrumbs, several footer links are broken (pointing to non-existent hash routes like `#glossary`, `#rates`, `#compare`, `#careers`), the FAQ page is not discoverable from header or footer, heading hierarchy is inconsistent across pages, and hash-based routing means no server-side rendering and potential SEO limitations. Cross-linking between pages is decent through CTA banners but some "Compare Features" links in the Comparisons tab are inert. Overall, users can accomplish core goals (find products, contact the company) but would struggle to find FAQ, and some secondary routes are dead ends. ### EVIDENCE - `src/components/Page.jsx:58-69` — `ROUTE_TO_NAV` map; some routes map to empty string (individuals, disclaimers, privacy, terms, accessibility), meaning no active nav highlight. - `src/components/Page.jsx:71-85` — `PAGE_ROUTES` Set defines all valid hash routes; includes legacy aliases and stub routes. `agent-portal` and `accessibility` are stub routes. - `src/components/Page.jsx:112-126` — `getRoute()` strips `#` and query string; `hashchange` event listener updates route; unknown hashes (not in `PAGE_ROUTES`) are ignored, letting browser scroll to in-page anchors. - `src/components/Page.jsx:134-138` — `goto()` sets `window.location.hash` directly; no `pushState`/`replaceState` — relies on hash fragment only. - `src/components/Page.jsx:145-184` — `renderPage()` switch: home (default), products, 7 product detail pages with legacy aliases, board, newsroom, white-papers, case-studies, retirement-risk, life-events, downloads, our-story, individuals, state-approval, disclaimers, privacy, terms, about→CompanyPage, client-resources, insights, professionals, sales-tools, agent-faqs, contact, blog, lpl-landing, cetera-landing, faq, leadership. Default case renders HomePage (catches unknown routes silently — no 404). - `src/components/Page.jsx:47-56` — `STUB_ROUTES`: `agent-portal` and `accessibility` render StubPage; no real content. - `src/components/Header.jsx:22-89` — `NAV_DROPDOWNS`: About (tabbed, 5 tabs including external Careers link), Products (tabbed, 3 tabs with 2–3 product links each), Client Resources (simple, 5 links with `?tab=` query params), Insights (simple, 3 links). Blog has no dropdown. - `src/components/Header.jsx:599` — `NAV_ITEMS = ["About", "Products", "Client Resources", "Insights", "Blog"]`. FAQ and Contact not in main nav. - `src/components/Header.jsx:600` — `AUD_ITEMS = ["Individuals", "Professionals"]` rendered as audience chips. - `src/components/Header.jsx:616` — Skip-to-content link: `Skip to main content`. - `src/components/Header.jsx:448-461` — NavItem without dropdown (Blog): renders as `` with `href={`#${name.toLowerCase()}`}`. - `src/components/Header.jsx:490-546` — `MobileNavContent`: simple dropdowns render flat link list; tabbed dropdowns render accordion-style with category labels and sub-links. - `src/components/Header.jsx:548-582` — `MobileNavItem`: accordion toggle; items without config render as direct-route buttons. - `src/components/Header.jsx:642-652` — Hamburger button: `aria-label="Open menu"`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls="mobile-nav-drawer"`. - `src/components/Header.jsx:656-662` — Overlay: clicking closes mobile nav. - `src/components/Header.jsx:665-715` — Drawer: slides in from right, contains logo (closes nav on click), close X button, scrollable nav items, CTA pills at bottom for Individuals/Professionals. - `src/components/Header.jsx:606-609` — Body scroll locked when mobile nav open: `document.body.style.overflow = "hidden"`. - `src/components/Footer.jsx:85-116` — Footer columns: Products (6 links, valid), Company (5 links, but `#careers` is not a valid route), Client Resources (5 links, but `#glossary`, `#rates`, `#compare` are not valid routes — they should be `#client-resources?tab=...`), Insights (4 links, valid including `#contact`). NO FAQ link in footer. - `src/components/Footer.jsx:204-211` — Bottom legal row: Privacy, Terms, Accessibility (all hash links, valid routes). - `src/index.html:6` — `Oceanview Life and Annuity` — static, never updated by JS. - `src/components/ProductsPage.jsx:166-170` — `CATEGORIES` with in-page anchor hrefs (`#prd-cat-...`) for scrolling within the page. - `src/components/ProductsPage.jsx:174-181` — `NAV_PRODUCTS` list for second-level tab; `IntersectionObserver` scroll-spy updates `activeProduct` state. - `src/components/NewsroomPage.jsx:141-157` — Filtering: `activeTab` (category) + `query` (text search), combined via `useMemo`. Filter for "Downloads" uses `hasDownload` boolean. Works correctly. - `src/components/NewsroomPage.jsx:167` — Has `

` for page title. - `src/components/ClientResourcesPage.jsx:366-370` — `tabFromURL()` reads `?tab=` from hash query string; validates against TABS array. Works correctly. - `src/components/ClientResourcesPage.jsx:252-265` — Comparisons tab: "Compare Features" links use `` with no `href`/`onClick` that navigates — they are inert. - `src/components/ClientResourcesPage.jsx:391` — Has `

` for page title. - `src/components/BlogPage.jsx:83-88` — `CATEGORIES` array; filtering by category pill buttons. Featured post linked via `href={FEATURED.href}` (`#blog-amBest` — not a real route). - `src/components/InsightsPage.jsx` — No `

`; featured section uses `

`, article cards use `

`. Linking: `PillMint` and `PillGhost` buttons navigate via `window.location.hash`. - `src/components/FAQPage.jsx` — Uses `PageHero`, accordion with 5 questions. CTA links to Contact. No `

` directly in component (likely in PageHero). - `src/components/AgentFAQsPage.jsx` — Uses `PageHero`, h2, h3. Category accordions with nested FAQ items. CTA to contact. - `src/components/CompanyPage.jsx` — Uses `PageHero`, h2. "Meet Our Leadership" button is `` with no onClick (inert). "Read our 2024 Annual Report" is `` with no href (inert). - `src/components/IndividualsPage.jsx:94` — No `

`; uses `

` throughout. Links to product detail via `window.location.hash`. - `src/components/ProfessionalsPage.jsx:94` — Has `

` "Tools and support built for financial advisors." - `src/components/ContactPage.jsx:17` — Has `

` style defined. Tabbed interface (Key Contacts, Payments, Portals, Forms) with sticky tab bar. - `src/components/StubPage.jsx` — Renders generic placeholder; used for agent-portal and accessibility routes. - `src/styles/tokens.css:450-469` — Skip-link CSS: positioned off-screen, slides in on `:focus-visible`. - `src/main.jsx:4` — App mounts via `createRoot(document.getElementById('app')).render()`. ### CHANGES None. ### RISKS - **Broken footer links**: `#glossary`, `#rates`, `#compare`, `#careers` are not valid hash routes. They silently fall through to HomePage, confusing users. Mitigation: update to `#client-resources?tab=Glossary` etc., or add these as PAGE_ROUTES entries. - **Inert CTAs**: CompanyPage "Meet Our Leadership" and "Read our 2024 Annual Report" buttons have no onClick/href. ClientResourcesPage Comparisons tab "Compare Features" links are similarly inert. Users click and nothing happens. Mitigation: wire them to appropriate routes. - **Static page title**: `` never updates from "Oceanview Life and Annuity" — harms SEO and accessibility (screen-reader users can't identify page from tab title). Mitigation: use `document.title` or a `<Helmet>`-style approach in each page component. - **No 404 handling**: Unknown hash routes silently render HomePage instead of showing a "page not found" message. Users may not realize they navigated to a broken link. Mitigation: add a 404/NotFound case in the switch. - **FAQ undiscoverable**: FAQ page has no entry in header nav, no footer link, and only reachable from... nowhere obvious. The footer Insights column includes Contact but not FAQ. Mitigation: add FAQ to header (possibly under About) or footer. - **Hash-only routing**: No `pushState` means all navigation is fragment-based. Browser back/forward works (hashchange fires), but URLs are not clean (always `/#something`), and deep-linking requires the hash. Server-side rendering is impossible without a real router. This is acceptable for an SPA marketing site but limits future scalability. - **Comparisons tab "Compare Features" links are dead**: These TextLink components have no navigation handler, making the comparison cards non-functional. Mitigation: link to individual product detail pages. - **Heading hierarchy inconsistency**: Some pages have h1 (NewsroomPage, ClientResourcesPage, ProfessionalsPage, ContactPage, ProductDetailPage), others do not (InsightsPage, IndividualsPage, ProductsPage, FAQPage, CompanyPage). Pages without h1 rely on PageHero which may or may not render one. Mitigation: audit all pages and ensure every page has exactly one h1. - **Query-string tab state is fragile**: `#client-resources?tab=Comparisons` relies on `URLSearchParams` parsing the hash fragment, which is non-standard. The `getRoute()` function strips the query string correctly for routing, and `tabFromURL()` reads it separately. This works but is brittle — changing the hash parsing logic could break deep links to specific tabs. Mitigation: consider a more robust approach or document this coupling. ### BLOCKERS None.

agents.result:
Now I have all the evidence I need. Let me compile the structured audit report.

---

### SUMMARY
I performed a comprehensive interaction design audit of the Oceanview React + Vite financial services marketing site by reading all 16 specified component files and the tokens.css stylesheet. The audit evaluated 10 interaction areas across ~4,500 lines of source code. The project has solid structural foundations (hash routing, sticky elements, carousel logic, dropdown keyboard support) but has significant gaps in state coverage: no `:active` press states exist anywhere, `prefers-reduced-motion` is only honored for the TickerBar, multiple CTA buttons are dead clicks with no `onClick` handlers, the Footer email signup form is completely non-functional, and the FAQPage accordion lacks keyboard accessibility. Below is the full structured report with severity ratings.

---

### EVIDENCE

- `src/styles/tokens.css:486-537` — Button system defines `.ov-btn:hover` for all 5 variants and `.ov-btn:focus-visible`, but **no `.ov-btn:active` state** (no press/tap feedback). Disabled state defined at line 533-537.
- `src/styles/tokens.css:870-874` — `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` media query **only disables `.ov-ticker-track` animation**; all other transitions (buttons, hero crossfade, drawer transform, card hover lifts) are not covered.
- `src/styles/tokens.css:432-447` — Desktop nav `.ov-nav-btn:focus-visible` and `.ov-aud-chip:focus-visible` defined with background + outline. Good keyboard support for header.
- `src/components/Hero.jsx:162-181` — Carousel logic: 6000ms auto-advance, pause on `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave`, manual dot/arrow click pauses auto-advance for 6000ms. Good pause-on-hover (line 192-193). **No touch/swipe handlers, no keyboard navigation on the carousel container.**
- `src/components/Hero.jsx:238-257` — Dot buttons and arrow buttons styled with `cursor: pointer` and `transition: background 0.2s ease` but **no `:hover` or `:focus-visible` styles** — the arrow button has a transition property but no hover rule to change background.
- `src/components/ProductsCard.jsx:95-98` — Two CTAs in the left column: `PillMint` "Compare Products" (line 95) and `TextLink` "Talk to a professional" (line 96) — **both have no `onClick` prop**. They render as buttons but do nothing.
- `src/components/CTAPanel.jsx:67-68` — `PillMint hero` "Explore Products" and `PillGhost light hero` "Contact Sales" — **both have no `onClick` prop**. Dead clicks.
- `src/components/Footer.jsx:80-136` — Email signup form: an `<input>` for email and a `<button type="submit">` exist but **there is no `onSubmit` handler on the form, no state management, no validation, and the `ack` message is never rendered**. The form is completely non-functional.
- `src/components/Footer.jsx:159-182` — Social media buttons (LinkedIn, Facebook, X): have `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave` for hover, but **no `onClick`, no `:focus`/`:focus-visible`, no `aria-label` accessibility on the Facebook and X buttons** (LinkedIn has `aria-label` at line 159, Facebook at 167, X at 175 — correction: they all have aria-labels actually). Still no onClick.
- `src/components/ContactPage.jsx:395-443` — `InquiryForm` component: multi-step form with conditional logic, success state (submitted view at line 429-443), but **no inline field validation errors, no email regex, no phone validation, no `handleSubmit` that actually sends data** (line 424-427 just sets `submitted = true`), and **no loading state**.
- `src/components/ContactPage.jsx:460-470` — The inquiry type `<select>` at line 461 uses `color` trick to show placeholder but **has no `required` attribute and no error styling if left unselected**.
- `src/components/FAQPage.jsx:47-55` — Accordion: toggle between open/closed via `useState(0)`, button has `cursor: pointer` but **no `aria-expanded`, no `aria-controls`, no keyboard event handlers** (Enter/Space won't toggle without JS handler), and **no transition/animation on the answer reveal** (conditional render with no CSS animation).
- `src/components/AgentFAQsPage.jsx:142-194` — `FAQCategory` component: category header and FAQ item both have `onMouseEnter`/`onMouseLeave` for hover feedback, but **no `:focus`/`:focus-visible`, no `aria-expanded`, no keyboard handlers**. Chevron icon rotates via `transition: transform .2s ease` — good.
- `src/components/Header.jsx:386-414` — Desktop dropdown: 300ms close delay (`schedClose`), `keepOpen` on panel hover, keyboard handlers for ArrowDown/ArrowUp/Escape/ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (lines 418-444). Good implementation. **No `:active` state on trigger buttons.**
- `src/components/Header.jsx:657-673` — Mobile drawer: overlay with opacity transition, drawer with transform translateX transition. Good animation. **No focus trap** (focus can escape the drawer when open), **no Escape key handler** to close the drawer.
- `src/components/Page.jsx:111-138` — Hash router: `getRoute()` parses `window.location.hash`, `hashchange` listener updates route, non-matching hashes pass through for native scroll. `goto` sets hash + scrolls to top. `ROUTE_TO_NAV` maps routes to nav highlight. Sound architecture.
- `src/components/Page.jsx:189-196` — TickerBar hide-on-scroll: `max-height` transition from 32px to 0 based on `window.scrollY > 10`. Works but **transition is not disabled by `prefers-reduced-motion`** since the media query only targets `.ov-ticker-track`.
- `src/components/TickerBar.jsx:17` — Ticker duplicates data for seamless loop. `src/styles/tokens.css:829` — `animation: tickerScroll 30s linear infinite`. Paused on hover at line 832-834.
- `src/components/TabBar.jsx:1-55` — TabBar component: keyboard navigation with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End (lines 14-27), `aria-selected`, `role="tab"`. Good accessibility. **No hover state defined** though.
- `src/components/BoardPage.jsx:119-120` — "Read Bio" / "Show less" button: has `cursor: pointer` but **no hover, focus, or active states defined**.
- `src/components/BoardPage.jsx:148` — CTABanner "Contact Us" button: has `onClick` → `window.location.hash = 'contact'`. ✅

- **Critical — Non-functional Footer email signup form**: The form renders but cannot be submitted. Users who type their email and click "Subscribe" will see nothing happen. This is a broken user-facing feature on every page. Mitigation: add `useState` for email, `onSubmit` handler, validation, and render the `ack` confirmation message.
- **Critical — Dead CTA buttons erode trust**: `ProductsCard` "Compare Products" and "Talk to a professional", plus `CTAPanel` "Explore Products" and "Contact Sales" — four prominent CTAs that do nothing on click. Users will perceive the site as broken. Mitigation: wire each to appropriate route navigation or external link.
- **Critical — `prefers-reduced-motion` only covers TickerBar**: Users with vestibular disorders will still receive full-motion button lifts, carousel crossfades, drawer slides, and card hover transforms. Mitigation: extend the media query to disable all `transition` and `animation` properties globally, or wrap each animated property in a `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` block.
- **High — No `:active` press state anywhere**: Every interactive element lacks tactile press feedback. On touch devices especially, users get no confirmation that their tap registered until the action completes (or doesn't). Mitigation: add `:active` pseudo-class styles to `.ov-btn`, nav items, tabs, dots, arrows, and accordion triggers.
- **High — FAQPage accordion inaccessible to keyboard users**: No `aria-expanded`, no `aria-controls`, and the `<button>` has no keyboard handler — but since it's a native `<button>`, Enter/Space do fire `onClick`. However, without `aria-expanded`, screen readers cannot announce state changes. Mitigation: add `aria-expanded={open === i}`, `aria-controls`, and `id` attributes for programmatic association.
- **High — Hero carousel lacks keyboard navigation**: Users who navigate via keyboard cannot pause, advance, or select slides in the carousel. Mitigation: add `onKeyDown` handler on the carousel section for ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, and ensure dots/arrows are in the natural tab order with clear focus indicators.
- **High — Mobile nav drawer has no focus trap**: When the drawer is open, keyboard focus can escape to elements behind the overlay. Mitigation: implement a focus trap that cycles focus within the drawer, or set `inert` on the main content when the drawer is open.
- **Medium — ContactPage form submits locally with no server communication**: The success message appears instantly with no actual data transmission. Users may believe their inquiry was sent when it wasn't. Mitigation: add actual fetch/axios call with loading and error states.
- **Medium — Hero dots/arrows have no hover or focus styles**: Small 8px dots and 44px arrow buttons provide no visual feedback on hover or keyboard focus, making them hard to discover and use. Mitigation: add `:hover` and `:focus-visible` styles (scale dots slightly, lighten arrow background).
- **Low — No `scroll-behavior: smooth` on html**: Only the ContactPage "Send us a message" button uses JS smooth scroll. Other anchor navigations jump instantly. Mitigation: add `scroll-behavior: smooth` to the `html` element in tokens.css for consistent behavior.
